answer: To block mass-produced identities, each identity grows a tree from deeds in an orchard. When a tree fails verification, a signal ripples to neighboring trees, identities linked to the fake. Rippled-to trees are re-verified, and failures signal in turn. 1000 fakes form one grove, so one catch ripples through all; only isolated fakes escape, and isolation costs endorsements. One honest agent tends one healthy tree; the ripple passes by.
